_comment: Rides and water activities acted out in 3D (components/interior/rides). kind = how it plays; track = which piece of the venue it uses (see rides/tracks.ts). realHeight (m) scales the speed shown to the real ride's.

leap-of-faith.label: Ride the Leap of Faith
leap-of-faith.desc: Climb the Tower of Neptune and drop near-vertically through a clear tube in the shark lagoon.
leap-of-faith.fact: A near-vertical plunge through a shark-filled lagoon at Aquaventure.

poseidons-revenge.label: Ride Poseidon's Revenge
poseidons-revenge.desc: Stand in the clear launch capsule, hear the countdown… then the floor drops away.
poseidons-revenge.fact: Riders stand in a capsule until a trapdoor opens beneath them.

aquaconda.label: Raft down the Aquaconda
aquaconda.desc: Pile into the big raft with other guests and spin down the giant tube together.
aquaconda.fact: A giant raft slide that carries up to six riders at a time.

aquaventure-river.label: Float the lazy river
aquaventure-river.desc: Sit back in a ring and drift around the island of palms. Pure chill.
aquaventure-river.fact: Aquaventure's river runs for over 2 km of rapids and calm water.

aquaventure-waves.label: Jump the waves
aquaventure-waves.desc: Wade into the wave pool and jump each wave as it rolls in.

jumeirah-sceirah.label: Race the Jumeirah Sceirah
jumeirah-sceirah.desc: Twin free-fall slides side by side: push off fast and beat the guest in the other lane.
jumeirah-sceirah.fact: Dubai's tallest free-fall slide: about 32 m up and close to 80 km/h.

tantrum-alley.label: Ride Tantrum Alley
tantrum-alley.desc: Spin through the tornado basins on a ring tube.
tantrum-alley.fact: Riders on rings whirl through three tornado-like funnels.

burj-surj.label: Ride Burj Surj
burj-surj.desc: A family ring ride that swirls round a giant bowl before the splash.

juhas-journey.label: Float Juha's Journey
juhas-journey.desc: Wild Wadi's lazy river: sit in a ring and drift around the park.
juhas-journey.fact: About 360 m of gentle river looping the park.

breakers-bay.label: Jump the waves in Breakers Bay
breakers-bay.desc: The region's biggest wave pool: time your jumps as the waves roll in.

wipeout-flowrider.label: Surf the Wipeout FlowRider
wipeout-flowrider.desc: Ride the surf machine: keep your balance, land tricks, try not to wipe out.
wipeout-flowrider.fact: A surf simulator pumping tonnes of water a second over a foam slope.

pool-swim.label: Swim laps
pool-swim.desc: Jump in and swim a lap there and back. Tap in rhythm to stroke faster.

pool-cannonball.label: Do a cannonball
pool-cannonball.desc: Run, jump, tuck at the top and make the biggest splash you can.

pool-float.label: Float on an inflatable
pool-float.desc: Lie back on a flamingo float and drift around the pool.

sea-swim.label: Swim out to the buoys
sea-swim.desc: Wade into the Arabian Gulf and swim out to the buoy line and back. Tap in rhythm to stroke.
sea-swim.fact: The Gulf is warm all year: around 23 °C in winter and over 32 °C in summer.

sunbathe.label: Sunbathe on a lounger
sunbathe.desc: Shades on, lie back and work on your tan. Turn over halfway, or you'll burn!

jet-ski.label: Ride a jet ski
jet-ski.desc: Hire a jet ski and race the buoy slalom out at sea. Steer through every gate.
jet-ski.fact: Jet skis must stay in marked zones off Dubai's beaches, away from swimmers.

paddleboard.label: Stand-up paddleboard
paddleboard.desc: Stand up, tap to paddle and keep your balance round the three buoys.

kitesurf.label: Kitesurf lesson
kitesurf.desc: Ride under the kite, time your pops for big jumps and tap again in the air to spin.
kitesurf.fact: Kite Beach gets steady afternoon sea breezes, which is how it got its name.

beach-volleyball.label: Play beach volleyball
beach-volleyball.desc: A rally match against a guest: first to 5. Tap just as the ball reaches you; perfect timing spikes it.

sandcastle.label: Build a sandcastle
sandcastle.desc: Pat the sand in a steady rhythm to build walls, towers, a moat and a flag. It stays on the beach while you're here.
